{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2020–21 |team=San Jose State Spartans |sport=Basketball |image= San Jose State Athletics wordmark.svg |image_size=250 |conference=Mountain West Conference |division= |short_conf=MW |record=5–16 |conf_record=3–13 |head_coach=[[Jean Prioleau]] |hc_year = 4th |asst_coach1=Will Kimble |asst_coach2=[[Julius Hodge]] |asst_coach3=Tim Marrion |stadium= |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2020–21 Mountain West Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 San Jose State Spartans men's basketball team''' represented [[San Jose State University]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by fourth-year head coach [[Jean Prioleau]] and were members of the [[Mountain West Conference]]. Due to [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19]] restrictions in [[Santa Clara County, California|Santa Clara County]], the Spartans could not play their home games at their normal home arena, [[Provident Credit Union Event Center]], and played their "home" games at different locations. == Previous season == The [[2019–20 San Jose State Spartans men's basketball team|Spartans]] finished the season 7–24, 3–15 in Mountain West play to finish in tenth place.
